scope: Every current missing/degraded engaged work for 25 Buddhist thinkers (Mādhyamaka, Yogācāra, Pramāṇa and other Buddhist) plus every Jaina thinker in data/thinkers.

catalogues: GRETIL complete git tree (public typed witness discovery)
SARIT full GitHub repository (open scholarly TEI)
DSBC complete Romanized browse catalogue (public readers)
limits: A catalogue presence is not a clean/public-source promotion. “typed-witness-route-found” requires the normal provenance, edition, completeness, and collation gate.
JainQQ.org returned Cloudflare anti-bot interstitial to direct HTTP retrieval; it is neither a positive nor a negative result.
DSBC reader text is scrapeable/publicly viewable but no bulk export was observed; use it as a reader/verification lane, not an automatically clean download.
E-Bharatisampat entries are treated as scans/readers unless a record independently proves a corrected Unicode transcription.
